q: How do I book a consultation?
a: Choose a service on the Consultations page and send your details — full name, date of birth, time and place of birth, and your question — over WhatsApp or the contact form. You'll get a confirmation and next steps for that specific service.

q: What information do I need to provide?
a: Full name, date of birth, place of birth, and as exact a birth time as you have. Birth time makes a real difference to chart accuracy, so use your birth certificate or hospital record if you have access to it. If you only have an approximate time, mention that and it will be accounted for.

q: What's the difference between a Focused Consultation and a Comprehensive Consultation?
a: Focused Consultations (Career, Relationship, Marriage Kundli Matching, Finance, Health) each answer one specific question in depth. The Comprehensive tiers — Personal Guidance, Video Consultation, and Premium Consultation — cover career, relationships, marriage, finance, family, and general direction together in a single longer session.

q: How will I receive my consultation?
a: Focused Consultations are delivered by email or voice note. Personal Guidance and Video Consultation are live calls. The Premium Consultation includes a video call plus a personalised PDF report covering the next six months, sent after the session.

q: Is my personal information kept confidential?
a: Yes. Birth details and anything shared during a consultation are used only to prepare your reading and are not shared with anyone else. See the Privacy Policy for details.

q: Can I reschedule or request a refund?
a: See the Cancellation & Refund Policy for the current terms — reach out before your session if your plans change and it will be looked at case by case.

q: Do you sell remedies like rudraksha, bracelets, or gemstones?
a: Yes — browse the Remedies section for rudraksha, bracelets, gemstones, and other recommended remedies, each with certification and delivery details where applicable.

q: Is Vedic astrology the same as Western astrology?
a: No. Vedic astrology uses the sidereal zodiac and a different calculation system from Western (tropical) astrology, which is why the same birth details can point to a different Moon sign or ascendant. Consultations here are based on Vedic astrology, Psychology, and related philosophy.
